name: Open the IoT dashboard and inspect a device
description: Verifies the primary command-center workflow loads the fleet and opens a device with telemetry.
expected: The fleet is visible and the selected device shows its current sensors and telemetry history.

name: Installable app shell works on mobile
description: Verifies the dashboard remains usable at a mobile viewport and exposes the installable application shell.
steps: Open the IoT Command Center at a mobile viewport
expected: The layouts remain usable on mobile and the application includes the manifest and service-worker-backed app shell.

name: Resolve an operational alert
description: Verifies operators can resolve an active alert and see its resolved state.
expected: The alert changes to its resolved state and no longer requires an action.

name: Send a device command and inspect the event
description: Verifies a device command creates an operational acknowledgement visible in Events.
steps: Press Restart and then open Events
expected: A command acknowledgement event is visible in the event stream.
